items.title: Leaving a Roth IRA to Your Kids? Why Dividend Stocks Make the 10-Year Rule Work for Them
items.summary: One stock in a six-pack of blue-chip dividend payers drives nearly two-fifths of the tax bill on an inherited portfolio, and it belongs somewhere else entirely. Your kids could pay for that mistake for decades.

items.title: Corporate Bonds vs. Dividend Stocks: Which Pays a Retiree More Reliably?
items.summary: Corporate bond yields just hit a 12-month high, yet that fat payout hides trade-offs in price risk, reinvestment, and taxes. For retirees weighing bonds against Procter & Gamble and Coca-Cola, the tax bill may decide the winner.

items.title: Turn $100,000 Into Lifetime Paychecks With These “Forever” Passive Income Dividend Stocks
items.summary: Four blue-chip dividend payers, from a drugmaker to an oil giant, promise income that grows while you never add a dollar. One of them yields more than double the others, and the reason behind that gap might surprise you.

items.title: If the Fed Hikes on Dec. 9, These 4 Dividend Stocks Are Built to Handle It
items.summary: Traders see a December rate rise as nearly certain, and it will separate dividends funded by surplus cash from those propped up by cheap debt. Which payouts, from pipelines to a Dividend King, look ready for the test?
